start: All gyms page, a working gym that used AI column matching this month

user_sees: 'Members in the register', 'Members in the app', 'Check-ins, 7 days', 'Gym takings this month', 'Staff', 'Wrong sign-in codes, 24 h', 'Last desk activity'
must_not: A tile showing NaN or undefined

user_sees: 'Reads a day for this gym' with 'Normal: <n>. 0 switches it off for this gym.'
must_not: Assistant use mixed into the column-matching count
